name: moneymind-financial-agent
description: MoneyMind AI — real-time financial behavior analysis MCP server. Exposes 16 live Neon DB tools for transaction analysis, behavior detection, decision coaching, scoring, and admin analytics.

tools.name: get_user_profile
tools.description: Retrieve a user profile including name, email, monthly income, monthly budget, and computed savings rate.

tools.name: get_monthly_stats
tools.description: Get current-month spending totals, transaction count, flagged count, projected month-end spend, and budget remaining.

tools.name: get_transactions
tools.description: Fetch recent transactions enriched with time-of-day tags (late-night / morning / afternoon / evening) for habit detection.

tools.name: get_flagged_transactions
tools.description: Get late-night and impulse purchases grouped by flag type with totals.

tools.name: get_category_breakdown
tools.description: Get per-category spending totals and transaction counts over a configurable time window.

tools.name: get_weekly_spending
tools.description: Get 8-week spending trend with week-over-week % change and direction (increasing / decreasing / stable).

tools.name: get_daily_spending
tools.description: Get day-by-day spending totals for the last N days to identify daily habits and weekend spikes.

tools.name: create_transaction
tools.description: Insert a new transaction. Automatically flags as late-night if the hour is between 22:00–04:59.

tools.name: detect_behavior
tools.description: Run pattern detection across 7 dimensions: late-night habits, food frequency, category overspend, impulse buying, weekly spikes, budget pace, and positive behavior. Optionally saves results to the DB.

tools.name: get_spending_score
tools.description: Calculate a 0–100 financial discipline score with letter grade across 5 weighted factors: budget adherence, impulse control, late-night spending, category concentration, and weekly trend.

tools.name: decision_coach
tools.description: Evaluate whether a user should make a specific purchase. Returns risk level (Low/Medium/High), risk score, recommendation, and alternatives based on live budget data.

tools.name: save_insight
tools.description: Persist a newly detected behavioral insight to the database so it appears on the user dashboard.

tools.name: get_behavior_insights
tools.description: Retrieve all AI-generated behavioral insights for a user (patterns, anomalies, trends, forecasts, positives) grouped by type.

tools.name: get_admin_overview
tools.description: Platform-wide aggregate stats: total users, transaction volume, flagged counts, and insight severity breakdown.

tools.name: get_admin_leaderboard
tools.description: Per-user spending leaderboard with transaction counts, flagged items, and insight counts for all users.

tools.name: get_admin_flagged_report
tools.description: The 100 most recent flagged transactions across all users, including user name and email.

tools.name: get_admin_spending_trend
tools.description: Platform-wide daily spending trend (total volume + flagged count per day) for the last N days.
